text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to Aaron and say to him: When you set up the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand.
text_cn: “你告诉亚郎说：你安放灯盏时，要使七盏灯光，光照灯台的前面。”

text_en: Aaron did so; he set up its lamps to give light in front of the lampstand, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 亚郎就照样做了：安放了灯盏，使灯光照耀灯台的前面，如上主对梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: Now this was how the lampstand was made, out of hammered work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was hammered work; according to the pattern that the Lord had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.
text_cn: 这灯台是用金子打成的，从座到花朵都是打成的；梅瑟是照上主指示的式样，制造了灯台。

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Take the Levites from among the Israelites and cleanse them.
text_cn: “你由以色列子民中选出肋未人，并要洁净他们。

text_en: Thus you shall do to them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of purification on them, have them shave their whole body with a razor and wash their clothes, and so cleanse themselves.
text_cn: 为洁净他们，你应这样做：将取洁水洒在他们身上，命他们用刀剃全身，然后洗自己的衣服，使自己洁净。

text_en: Then let them take a young bull and its grain offering of choice flour mixed with oil, and you shall take another young bull for a sin offering.
text_cn: 以后，他们应带一只公牛犊和同献的素祭，即油调的细面；你应另带一头公牛犊，为作赎罪祭；

text_en: You shall bring the Levites before the tent of meeting, and assemble the whole congregation of the Israelites.
text_cn: 领肋未人到会幕前，并召集以色列子民全会众。

text_en: When you bring the Levites before the Lord , the Israelites shall lay their hands on the Levites,
text_cn: 领肋未人到上主面前以后，以色列子民将自己的手放在肋未人身上，

text_en: and Aaron shall present the Levites before the Lord as an elevation offering from the Israelites, that they may do the service of the Lord .
text_cn: 亚郎就以摇礼把肋未人献于上主面前，当作以色列子民的献仪：这样，他们才可以行服事上主的事。

text_en: The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and he shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the Lord , to make atonement for the Levites.
text_cn: 以后肋未人应按手在两头公牛犊头上：一只你要献给上主作赎罪祭，一只作全燔祭，为肋未人赎罪。

text_en: Then you shall have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons, and you shall present them as an elevation offering to the Lord .
text_cn: 你应使肋未人站在亚郎和他的儿子们面前，以摇礼把他们献给上主。

text_en: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the other Israelites, and the Levites shall be mine.
text_cn: 为此，你要由以色列子民中分出肋未人来，使他们属于我。

text_en: Thereafter the Levites may go in to do service at the tent of meeting, once you have cleansed them and presented them as an elevation offering.
text_cn: 此后，肋未人才可进入会幕服务。为此你应洁净他们，以摇礼奉献他们，

text_en: For they are unreservedly given to me from among the Israelites; I have taken them for myself, in place of all that open the womb, the firstborn of all the Israelites.
text_cn: 因为他们是以色列子民中完全献与我的人；我使他们归于我。以代替以色列子民中一切开胎的首生，

text_en: For all the firstborn among the Israelites are mine, both human and animal. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I consecrated them for myself,
text_cn: 因为以色列子民中的一切首生，不拘是人是兽，都属于我；自从我在埃及地击杀了一切首生的那一日起，我就将他们祝圣归属于我。

text_en: but I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the Israelites.
text_cn: 我取了肋未人，替代以色列子民中的一切首生；

text_en: Moreover, I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the Israelites, to do the service for the Israelites at the tent of meeting, and to make atonement for the Israelites, in order that there may be no plague among the Israelites for coming too close to the sanctuary.
text_cn: 我由以色列子民中委派了肋未人，作亚郎和他儿子们的属下，为替代以色列子民在会幕内服务，为以色列子民赎罪，免得以色列子民因接近圣所而遭受灾祸。”

text_en: Moses and Aaron and the whole congregation of the Israelites did with the Levites accordingly; the Israelites did with the Levites just as the Lord had commanded Moses concerning them.
text_cn: 梅瑟、亚郎以及以色列子民全会众，对肋未人就如此做了；上主关于肋未人怎样吩咐了梅瑟，以色列子民就对他们怎样做了。

text_en: The Levites purified themselves from sin and washed their clothes; then Aaron presented them as an elevation offering before the Lord , and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
text_cn: 肋未人洁净了自己，洗了自己的衣服，亚郎遂以摇礼把他们献在上主面前，亚郎并为他们赎了罪，使他们洁净。

text_en: Thereafter the Levites went in to do their service in the tent of meeting in attendance on Aaron and his sons. As the Lord had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did with them.
text_cn: 此后，肋未人才进入会幕内，在亚郎和他的儿子们面前执行自己的职务。上主关于肋未人怎样吩咐了，梅瑟就对他们怎样做了。

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: This applies to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall begin to do duty in the service of the tent of meeting;
text_cn: “这是关于肋未人的法令：由二十五岁以上，应来服役，在会幕内工作；

text_en: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from the duty of the service and serve no more.
text_cn: 到了五十岁就退休，不再服役；

text_en: They may assist their brothers in the tent of meeting in carrying out their duties, but they shall perform no service. Thus you shall do with the Levites in assigning their duties.
text_cn: 以后在会幕内辅助自己的兄弟照管该遵守的事，自己却不必服劳役。关于肋未人的职务，你应这样安排。”
